prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
Do you mean spray (sunless) tanning or UV tanning beds? Also, what part of Charlotte are you near (Uptown, South End, Ballantyne, University area, etc.) and do you want budget, mid-range, or luxury service? 

If you tell me those, I can give a short list of the top-rated salons in your area with addresses, phone numbers, prices, and what each is best for. 

Meanwhile, quick tips for choosing the best salon:
- Pick spray/airbrush if you want a fast, low-risk glow; pick UV only if you understand the skin-cancer/aging risks and plan very limited sessions.
- Look for salons using reputable solutions (Norvell, VersaSpa, Mystic) and experienced techs (ask to see before/after photos or reviews).
- Check cleanliness and private rooms; request a patch test if you’ve never used their solution.
- Ask about prep (exfoliation, no lotions) and aftercare (moisturizers, avoiding long showers) to get a longer, more even tan.
- Read recent Google/Yelp reviews and confirm prices/membership deals before booking.

Tell me the tanning type and neighborhood and I’ll pull together the best local options.
